Require handbook-first extraction of all limits/regions into a config object before computation and forbid guessing unspecified thresholds. Add a final validation checklist confirming every requested run/family is represented, all files exist at the correct paths, outputs are valid JSON with no extra keys/text, and all values derive only from handbook and provided datasets.
